title: Verifiable Intent Immediate mode (two layers, user present)
summary: The user reviews a final cart and signs L2 with final checkout and payment mandates. The agent forwards L1 and L2; the merchant sees the checkout side and the network sees the payment side. No L3 is created.

steps.label: Issue L1 (sd+jwt)
steps.detail: The issuer, a bank or Mastercard on its behalf, signs L1 binding the user's public key in cnf.jwk. Lifetime about one year.

steps.label: Present final cart and checkout_jwt
steps.detail: The agent builds the cart and obtains a checkout_jwt from the merchant; its format and signing are implementation-defined in 0.1.

steps.label: Sign L2 Immediate (kb-sd-jwt)
steps.detail: The user signs L2 with the key from L1 cnf.jwk. It holds mandate.checkout.1 with checkout_hash and mandate.payment.1 with transaction_id equal to that hash. No cnf in mandates, so no further delegation. Lifetime about 15 minutes.

steps.label: L1 + L2, checkout disclosed
steps.detail: The merchant verifies the L1 signature with the issuer JWKS, L2 with L1 cnf.jwk, sd_hash, and recomputes checkout_hash against its own checkout.

failures.condition: checkout_hash does not match the merchant checkout

steps.label: L1 + L2, payment disclosed
steps.detail: The network verifies the chain and the transaction_id binding as a pre-authorization step. The issuer still makes the final decision.

failures.condition: L2 exp passed (300 second skew recommended)
